hostname ix-u01
!
ip prefix-list pl-u-ospf 5 permit 198.51.100.0/24 max 28
!
route-map rm-u-out permit 10
  set community delete 64497:100 64497:200
!
ip router ospf 1
  router-id 192.0.2.1
  distance external 115 inter-area 115 intra-area 115
  distribute-list prefix pl-u-ospf
  area 1 virtual-link 192.0.2.9 dead-interval 20 hello-interval 5
  originate-default always metric 50 metric-type 1
  network GigaEthernet1.0 area 0
!
router bgp 64496
  router-id 192.0.2.1
  timers 20 60
  neighbor 192.0.2.2 remote-as 64496
  neighbor 192.0.2.2 update-source Loopback0.0
  neighbor 192.0.2.2 timers 10 30
  neighbor 192.0.2.2 route-reflector-client
  neighbor 192.0.2.3 remote-as 64496
  neighbor 192.0.2.3 update-source Loopback0.0
  neighbor 192.0.2.3 timers 10 30
  neighbor 192.0.2.3 route-reflector-client
  neighbor 203.0.113.2 remote-as 64497
  neighbor 203.0.113.2 advertisement-interval 15
  address-family ipv4 unicast
    network 198.51.100.0/24
    aggregate-address 198.51.100.0/23 summary-only
    distance ebgp 30 ibgp 190
    neighbor 192.0.2.2 next-hop-self
    neighbor 192.0.2.3 next-hop-self
    neighbor 203.0.113.2 route-map rm-u-out out
    neighbor 203.0.113.2 send-default
!
interface GigaEthernet0.0
  description to sample upstream
  ip address 203.0.113.1/30
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet1.0
  description sample lan
  ip address 198.51.100.1/24
  ip ospf hello-interval 10
  ip ospf dead-interval 40
  no shutdown
!
interface Loopback0.0
  ip address 192.0.2.1/32
!
